result.topic_en: Notes on elliptic integrals for a cubic R(x)=(x-a_1)(x-a_2)(x-a_3): definition of a normalized third-kind integral Ω(x,a), first- and second-kind integrals ω(x), ϖ(x) with periods, and a period-relation-type combination; the left page has a sketch of cuts/paths with the condition ∫u dv = 0.

Right page:
$\mathcal{R}(x) = (x-a_1)(x-a_2)(x-a_3)$
$\int \frac{1}{2}\left(1 + \frac{\sqrt{\mathcal{R}(a)}}{\sqrt{\mathcal{R}(x)}}\right)\frac{dx}{x-a} = \Omega(x,a)$
$\int \frac{dx}{2\sqrt{\mathcal{R}(x)}} = \omega(x) \quad \mathfrak{K}$
$\int \frac{(x-a_1)\,dx}{2\sqrt{\mathcal{R}(x)}} = \varpi(x) \quad \mathfrak{J}$
$\mathfrak{K}\,\omega(a) - \mathfrak{J}\,\varpi(a)$
$-\mathfrak{K}\,\omega(b) + \mathfrak{J}\,\varpi(b)$

methods.what: Cubic polynomial defining an elliptic curve
Elliptic integral of the third kind (normalized) with pole at a
Elliptic integral of the first kind with period K
Elliptic integral of the second kind with period J
Combination of periods and integral values (interchange of argument and parameter for third-kind integral)
Vanishing of a boundary integral around cuts (bilinear relation argument)
